title: No More Zombified Spear
description: This data pack replaces the zombified piglin's golden spear with a golden sword.
body:
# This data pack ensures that no zombified piglin has a spear. 
By running a command every tick, if a zombified piglin has a spear, it will be replaced with a sword.
It should be working in all of the listed versions.

**If not, you can contact me via discord: rusho.00**

---
